insight: Founded in 2022 in San Francisco by Filip Skrzesinski and Irvin Zhan.
name: Subframe
tagline: AI-native design tool that ships production React + Tailwind code.
description: Subframe is a code-first design tool where you build interfaces from real, code-backed components on a visual canvas and export clean, production-ready React and Tailwind CSS. Designs map deterministically to code — what you draw is the code you ship — and connect to coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code via MCP. It syncs with Figma and auto-generates a custom design system.

modelSupport.notes: Built-in AI generation plus MCP hooks into agents like Cursor and Claude Code.

edge: Outputs deterministic production React/Tailwind from real components — what you design is the code you ship — and exposes designs to agents via MCP.
cons: Scoped to the React + Tailwind stack

references.title: Subframe: AI Design Tool With MCP for Coding Agents
